events.title: "White Album" Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic "White Album" was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: A Double Dose of Genius
angles.copy: On this day in '68, The Beatles unleashed the sprawling, eclectic masterpiece known simply as 'The White Album'. A double dose of genius that still sounds fresh today.

events.title: Freddie Mercury Tribute
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: Remembering the legend, Freddie Mercury, who left us on this day. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy – truly unmatched.

events.title: "Rubber Soul" Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album "Rubber Soul" on this day in 1965.

angles.name: A Pivotal Album
angles.copy: On this day in '65, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that showed their incredible evolution and songwriting depth.

events.title: John Lennon Tribute
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the tragic death of The Beatles' John Lennon.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, a visionary artist and advocate for peace, who we lost on this day. His message continues to resonate.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary artist David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: The Starman's Legacy
angles.copy: Today, the iconic David Bowie would have turned 80. Forever the Starman, his influence on music, fashion, and culture is simply immeasurable.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: On this day, the one and only King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have turned 92. His legend truly lives on.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! The Led Zeppelin axe-man who gave us some of the most iconic riffs in rock history.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Rock and pop icon Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Raise a glass! The inimitable Sir Rod Stewart turns 82 today. Still rocking, still got that voice, still absolutely brilliant.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Our House Icon
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs from Madness! Still bringing the house down after all these years.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Simply The Best
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the soulful voice of Paul Young! From 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' to 'Every Time You Go Away', he's simply the best.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music legend and cultural icon Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true icon, songwriter, and force of nature. What a woman!

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and singer-songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: A National Treasure
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That to his incredible solo career, a true British songwriting talent.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen of Soul
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the smooth-voiced Billy Ocean! Still 'Suddenly' making us want to dance.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame Inaugural
events.blurb: The first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place on this day in 1989.

angles.name: Legends Inducted
angles.copy: On this day in '89, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its first induction ceremony. Imagine the legends in that room!

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Forever a Boybander
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! From Take That heartthrob to solo artist, still got that charm.

events.title: Beatles Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the Apple Corps rooftop on this day in 1969.

angles.name: The Final Bow
angles.copy: On this day in '69, The Beatles played their iconic, impromptu rooftop concert – their last ever live performance. A truly legendary moment in music history.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Genesis drummer and solo artist Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: In The Air Tonight
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the incredible Phil Collins! A drumming legend and a voice that defined a generation.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: British actor Hugh Grant celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Charming at 67
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the effortlessly charming Hugh Grant! Still the rom-com king, and a national treasure.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Bringing SexyBack
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From boybander to solo sensation, he's still got the moves.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly!
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason! A true icon of British television, forever making us laugh.

events.title: The Day The Music Died Tribute
events.blurb: This day marks the tragic anniversary of the plane crash that killed Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper in 1959.

angles.name: A Tragic Loss
angles.copy: Remembering 'The Day The Music Died'. On this day in 1959, we lost Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper in a tragic plane crash. Their music lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Rick Astley celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the man who's never gonna give you up, Rick Astley! Still a legend.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae icon Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One Love, One Legend
angles.copy: On this day, the incomparable Bob Marley would have turned 82. His message of 'One Love' and his timeless music continue to inspire the world.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Carole King celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Tapestry of Talent
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the extraordinary Carole King! A songwriting genius whose 'Tapestry' of hits defined a generation.

events.title: Whitney Houston Tribute
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the passing of the legendary vocalist Whitney Houston.

angles.name: The Voice Remembered
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Whitney Houston, who we lost on this day. Her voice remains one of the greatest of all time.

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of Take That's initial split in 1996.

angles.name: Back For Good
angles.copy: On this day in '96, hearts broke as Take That announced their split. But thankfully, they were 'Back For Good'!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Red, Red Wine & Reggae
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell of UB40! The voice behind so many reggae-pop classics.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global superstar Ed Sheeran celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Perfectly Talented
angles.copy: Happy 36th birthday to the one and only Ed Sheeran! A songwriting phenomenon and global superstar.
